title: EPFO ने लॉन्च किए VISHWAS, 2026 और AMNESTY, 2026: पुराने PF मामलों को सुलझाने का नया मौका!
content:
# EPFO ने लॉन्च किए VISHWAS, 2026 और AMNESTY, 2026: पुराने PF मामलों को सुलझाने का नया मौका!

Ek important update hai! Government ne Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) ke through do one-time initiatives—VISHWAS, 2026 aur AMNESTY, 2026—announce kiye hain. Iska maksad employers ko long-pending disputes settle karne aur legacy provident fund trust cases ko regularise karne mein help karna hai, jisse employees ke liye social security coverage aur behtar ho sake.

Ye dono schemes 29 June 2026 se effective ho chuke hain aur agle six months tak open rahenge.

*   **VISHWAS, 2026: Dispute Resolution Scheme**
    *   Yeh ek one-time dispute resolution scheme hai.
    *   Iske through employers Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 aur Code on Social Security, 2020 ke under damages aur penalties se related disputes settle kar sakte hain.
    *   Iska aim litigation ko kam karna aur voluntary compliance ko promote karna hai, poora process transparent, fully online aur time-bound hoga.
    *   Scheme mein court aur tribunals mein pending cases, recovery pending cases, notices issued but final orders pending cases, aur jin cases mein notices issue nahi hue hain, woh sab cover honge.
    *   14 June 2024 se pehle ke defaults ke liye damages ko substantially reduced rates par recalculate kiya jayega (e.g., 0.25% per month for defaults up to two months, 0.50% per month for delays from two to less than four months, and 1.00% per month for defaults exceeding four months).
    *   **Notification:** Scheme has been notified vide G.S.R. 525(E) dated 29 June 2026.

*   **AMNESTY, 2026: Regularisation of Legacy PF Trusts**
    *   Yeh ek one-time regularisation scheme hai un eligible establishments ke liye jo recognized Provident Fund Trusts operate kar rahe hain but unke paas EPF Act ya Code on Social Security ke under formal exemption nahi hai.
    *   Isse eligible trusts ko retrospective regularisation ka mauka milega.
    *   **Eligibility:** Woh establishments jo Income Tax Act, 1961 ke under recognized PF Trust chala rahe hain, par unke paas appropriate Government se formal exemption notification nahi hai.
    *   **Notification:** Scheme was notified on 29 June 2026. Detailed procedures Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, 2026 ke Annexure ke Part C mein hain, jo Gazette Notification GSR 525(E) dated June 29, 2026 ke through notify hua hai.
